video_title: Warriors' pursuit of LeBron & AD, Blazers' plans after acquiring Ja Morant & more | SportsCenter

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Golden State's salary cap constraints limit their ability to sign LeBron and AD
quotes.excerpt: If you sign LeBron James to a $15 million contract, you don't have room to fill out the roster.
quotes.quote: Why it's complicated is where Golden State is with salary right now. With the Kristaps Porzingis contract, they're at $177 million in salary. The first apron hard cap is $209 million. That basically leaves them $32 million below that number. Remember, Draymond Green opted out of that $27 million number. You're expecting that it's probably going to come in somewhere between that $20 million range. If you sign LeBron James to a $15 million contract, you don't have room to fill out the rest of your roster here. So, you will have to go out and make a trade and clear out some room to do so.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Washington Wizards have significant leverage in any Anthony Davis trade talks
quotes.excerpt: The Washington Wizards want to extend Anthony Davis and they have a lot of leverage here.
quotes.quote: The Anthony Davis part is also complicated. What do the Washington Wizards want? We forgot about the Wizards here. They're saying, 'Hey, we traded for Anthony Davis, we would like to extend him here,' and they have a lot of leverage here. And if you're the Wizards and Golden State wants Anthony Davis, you would certainly want to take basically every draft asset they have, including all three of their first-round picks.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Memphis Grizzlies traded Ja Morant because his value had plummeted
quotes.excerpt: Memphis felt like it was time. Ja Morant's value for all intents and purposes had just plummeted.
quotes.quote: Memphis felt like it was time. They had to turn the page and Ja Morant's value for all intents and purposes had just plummeted over the last several months, especially once they made Ja Morant available last season. It was time for them to move on. So, they scoured the league for different trade options and they landed on this deal with the Portland Trail Blazers. They get a veteran forward back in Jeremy Grant, but clearly for Portland, this is all about the Trail Blazers and this was a swing.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Portland's roster fit for Ja Morant, Damian Lillard, and other guards
quotes.excerpt: The basketball fit is going to be very interesting now in Portland because they've got a slew of guards.
quotes.quote: The basketball fit is going to be very interesting now in Portland because they've got a slew of guards. Ja Morant, Scoot Henderson, Drew Holiday, they've got Damian Lillard who missed all of last season. He's on his way back. So, how are they going to make that all fit with one basketball? That's something that I know everyone in Portland is trying to figure out right now. But they felt like getting that talent in and then figuring it out later, if that means trading one of those guards at some other point, they'll look at that as well.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Ja Morant needs to improve his shooting efficiency in Portland
quotes.excerpt: He shot under 50% from the paint for the first time ever in his career.
quotes.quote: I think you'll have a little bit more room to operate. This is a guy that last year, per qualified players, was still sixth best in the NBA in drives, but he shot under 50% from the paint for the first time ever in his career. So hopefully a little bit less pressure, a little bit less usage, owning the transition game, and then making sure the guys like Scoot Henderson and Jaden Hardy still can also be dynamic as well.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's supermax contract complicates trade talks for Boston
quotes.excerpt: You combine the contract that he's on, he's got three years left on his supermax clip.
quotes.quote: The conversation hasn't been about Jaylen Brown's game. Everyone knows Jaylen Brown is an elite player, but you combine the contract that he's on, he's got three years left on his supermax clip and where we're at in the off-season right now, what you're seeing is a price variance based on the player he is and the contract he's at and the assets that are available. There's a stark variance among those three categories.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Boston offered Jaylen Brown and two first-round picks for Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.excerpt: The Celtics have gone out in the marketplace. They offered Jaylen Brown and two first-round picks for Giannis Antetokounmpo.
quotes.quote: The Celtics have gone out in the marketplace. We know they've offered Jaylen Brown and two first-round picks for Giannis Antetokounmpo. They made a calculation that we believe Giannis is a better player than Jaylen Brown, so we're going to make that trade. The Bucks obviously didn't do that deal, they went to Miami with it. So now the Celtics are here, Jaylen Brown's name is out there, and they continue to scour the market.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown should feel disrespected by Boston's trade attempts
quotes.excerpt: If I'm Jaylen Brown, I feel some type of way coming back.
quotes.quote: They could come out with all the reports that they want to, but again, some of the stuff, and I'm not saying he's a criminal, but I'm saying the streaming and stuff like that, that has been a turnoff to a lot of people. But if you're Brad Stevens, you cannot bring that energy back into your locker room because if I'm Jaylen Brown, I feel some type of way coming back and I'm saying, 'Well damn, you didn't try to trade me twice. How you expect me to act?' I just came off the best season of my career and here I was on the chopping block.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Clippers and Raptors are in serious trade talks for Kawhi Leonard
quotes.excerpt: Those talks are continuing. They're serious between the Clippers and the Raptors.
quotes.quote: Those talks are continuing. They're serious between the Clippers and the Raptors on what would bring Kawhi Leonard back to the six, back to Toronto. And those conversations have continued today. We'll see how the conversations go for the next few hours, potentially into tomorrow. But all signs point to these two sides being motivated and the future is nearing its end.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Clippers have not offered Kawhi Leonard a contract extension
quotes.excerpt: He has not been given any indication that the Clippers want to give him a contract extension.
quotes.quote: He has not been given any indication that the Clippers want to give him a contract extension. He has one year and about $50 million left on his contract. So if the Clippers are not going to give him a contract extension, there are multiple other teams out there in the marketplace that would give him a contract extension. He's coming off a second team all-NBA season.
